concept.description: Labels script / expression evaluation entry points (Rhino, JSR-223, Groovy, SpEL) as :ScriptEvaluation and :HeavyWork.
concept.cypher: MATCH (lt:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method) WHERE (lt.fqn = 'org.mozilla.javascript.Context' AND coalesce(m.name, last(split(split(m.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) IN ['evaluateString', 'evaluateReader', 'initStandardObjects', 'initSafeStandardObjects', 'compileString']) OR (lt.fqn IN ['javax.script.ScriptEngine', 'javax.script.Compilable'] AND coalesce(m.name, last(split(split(m.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) IN ['eval', 'compile']) OR (lt.fqn IN ['groovy.lang.GroovyShell', 'groovy.util.Eval'] AND coalesce(m.name, last(split(split(m.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) IN ['evaluate', 'parse', 'me', 'x']) OR (lt.fqn STARTS WITH 'org.springframework.expression.' AND coalesce(m.name, last(split(split(m.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) IN ['parseExpression']) SET m:ScriptEvaluation:HeavyWork RETURN count(DISTINCT m) AS ScriptMethods

constraint.description: Evaluating scripts or expressions from code allows arbitrary code execution when any part is user controlled: remove it or sandbox it behind an allow-list.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method)-[:INVOKES]->(s:Method:ScriptEvaluation) WHERE NOT t:Test RETURN DISTINCT m AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, s.signature AS Detail
